scope_limits: Direct first-party programme evidence applies to named celebrations only, never all Masses in the building.
No public assertion of Una Cum, pontiff named in Canon, canonical status, or celebrant identity.
A schedule page is not proof of live Mass availability. Verify current exceptions before travel.
Source-identity join requires exact frozen CL2 physical anchor, R49 source ID, official venue name and publisher URL.
These records do not promote the 2715 unapproved CL27 research classifications or institute-wide norms.

records.detail_en: The parish programme explicitly identifies 1962 Low and High Masses alongside Masses using the 2002 Missal.
records.detail_fr: Le programme paroissial indique explicitement des messes basses et des grand-messes selon le missel de 1962, parallèlement à des messes selon le missel de 2002.
records.exception_en: First Sundays use the 2002 Missal for the normally listed Sunday 7:30 a.m. and 12:30 p.m. slots; feast-day and seasonal schedules may differ.
records.exception_fr: Les premiers dimanches, le missel de 2002 remplace celui de 1962 aux horaires habituels de 7 h 30 et 12 h 30 ; les fêtes et périodes particulières peuvent modifier les horaires.

records.label_en: 1962 liturgical books for marked Latin Masses
records.label_fr: Livres liturgiques de 1962 pour les messes latines signalées
records.detail_en: The parish schedule explicitly states that its asterisk-marked Latin Masses follow the 1962 liturgical books; other Masses remain separate.
records.detail_fr: Le programme paroissial précise que les messes latines marquées d’un astérisque suivent les livres liturgiques de 1962 ; les autres messes restent distinctes.
records.exception_en: The first-Sunday Latin rows are not asterisked; no 1962 edition is inferred for those slots. Check the current parish schedule.
records.exception_fr: Les messes latines du premier dimanche ne portent pas d’astérisque ; on ne leur attribue donc pas le missel de 1962. Vérifier le programme paroissial à jour.
